text:
sana: hi folks — first day! stuck at the Okta MFA step. SMS isn't arriving to my Singapore number (+65). tried twice. anyone seen SG carriers drop verification?
it-support: welcome Sana! occasionally international SMS can be flaky. did you type the +65 country code? what's the last 3 digits?
sana: yep +65 and ends with 321. i get other SMS fine (banks/whatsapp). also my 1Password invite went to my personal account by mistake.
people-ops: @sana we can resend 1Password to your work email and issue temporary drive access. do you need GitHub right away?
sana: need repo access to clone infra examples. also I asked for a YubiKey but shipping ETA shows 2 weeks. any short-term hardware key alternatives?
it-support: resend 1P now to sana@redwood.ai. short-term: app TOTP (Authy/Google Authenticator) or software FIDO via browser extension works for dev access. note: we prefer hardware keys for prod later.
onboarding-bot: 1Password invite resent to sana@redwood.ai (sent).
it-support: we can generate Okta backup codes and a one-time bypass for 12h so you can finish setup. which do you want?
sana: bypass + backup codes please. and can someone add me to repo:example-app (read) so I can start?
devops: added sana to example-app (Read). GitHub org seat provisioning can be delayed ~10min after SSO claim — ping if not in 15. also need your SSH public key to speed PR workflow.
sana: pasting key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIC... sana@redwood.ai
it-support: backup codes DM'd. bypass enabled for 12h. try signing in again and set up an authenticator app; it will be more reliable than SMS.
sana: ok signed in using a backup code, registered Authenticator, 1Password arrived and i joined org. thanks!
infra-bot: note: dev seat assigned to sana@redwood.ai, temp-bypass expires in 2024-11-21T08:15:00Z.
people-ops: quick pro-tip: once you get your YubiKey, add it in Okta > Security > Multifactor. save at least 5 recovery codes in 1Password. onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboard/quickstart
devops: for CI access, we created a short-lived deploy token tied to your github user (expires 7 days). request extension via eng-sre if you need longer.
sana: confirmed CI token received, can clone and run the quickstart. appreciate the fast help everyone :blue_heart:
